notes: Corrected the two Serenade titles, which wrongly put their opus numbers as Op. 56 No. 1 and Op. 92 No. 2, and filled the missing Op. 56 duration from IMSLP. Op. 92 has no duration given and I am not sure of it, so I left it unset; serenade keys are also unverified and left out. Levels for the queued works look plausible against the concertos (L8) and Suite Op. 10 (L8). I could not verify the details of the smaller queued sets (Opp. 9, 30, 43, 61, 81, 89, 106, 123), so I left them unchanged.
